text:
Entity: dbo.accounts
Description: Represents bank accounts with details such as account ID, customer ID, account type, balance in USD, and open date.
Concpets: List all accounts, Find account by ID, Get account balance, Retrieve account history, Identify customer associated with an account, Update account details, Calculate total account balance, Find accounts with specific type

Entity: dbo.accounts
Column: account_id
Description: Unique identifier for each account.
Synonyms: Account Number, Bank Account ID, Customer's Account

Entity: dbo.accounts
Column: customer_id
Description: ID of the customer associated with the account.
Synonyms: Customer ID, Customer Account, Customer's Bank Account

Entity: dbo.accounts
Column: account_type
Description: Type of account (e.g., savings, checking, etc.).
Synonyms: Account Type, Account Category, Account Category ID

Entity: dbo.accounts
Column: balance_usd
Description: Current balance of the account in USD.
Synonyms: Account Balance, Bank Balance, USD Balance

Entity: dbo.accounts
Column: open_date
Description: Date when the account was opened.
Synonyms: Account Open Date, Account Opening Date, Account Opened Date

Relationship:
dbo.accounts.customer_idreferences dbo.customers.customer_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from accounts to customers.

Entity: dbo.branches
Description: Information about branches including their names, managers, and locations.
Concpets: List of branches, Branch manager details, Branch location information, Branch name lookup, Branch manager contact information, Branch city and country details, Branches by manager, Branches by city

Entity: dbo.branches
Column: branch_id
Description: Unique identifier for each branch
Synonyms: Branch ID, Branch code, Branch reference

Entity: dbo.branches
Column: branch_name
Description: Name of the branch
Synonyms: Branch name, Facility name, Office name

Entity: dbo.branches
Column: manager_name
Description: Name of the manager for the branch
Synonyms: Manager name, Manager's name, Manager's full name

Entity: dbo.branches
Column: city
Description: City where the branch is located
Synonyms: City name, City of branch, Branch city

Entity: dbo.branches
Column: country
Description: Country where the branch is located
Synonyms: Country name, Branch country, Location country

Entity: dbo.cards
Description: Card information table
Concpets: card details, account associated with card, card type, card expiration date, card ID, account ID, card expiration date in datetime format

Entity: dbo.cards
Column: card_id
Description: Unique identifier for each card
Synonyms: card number, card reference, card ID number

Entity: dbo.cards
Column: account_id
Description: ID of the account associated with the card
Synonyms: account reference, account ID, account number

Entity: dbo.cards
Column: card_type
Description: Type of the card (e.g., credit, debit)
Synonyms: card type, card kind, payment method

Entity: dbo.cards
Column: expiration_date
Description: Date when the card expires
Synonyms: card expiry date, card expiration date, card expiry

Relationship:
dbo.cards.account_idreferences dbo.accounts.account_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from cards to accounts

Entity: dbo.customers
Description: Customer information including their ID, name, email, city, credit score, and creation timestamp.
Concpets: List of customers, Customer details, Customer ID, Customer name, Customer email, Customer city, Customer credit score, Customer creation date

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: customer_id
Description: Unique identifier for each customer.
Synonyms: Customer ID, Customer Ref, Customer Code

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: first_name
Description: The first name of the customer.
Synonyms: First Name, Forename, Given Name

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: last_name
Description: The last name of the customer.
Synonyms: Last Name, Surname, Family Name

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: email
Description: The email address of the customer.
Synonyms: Email Address, Contact Email, Email

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: city
Description: The city where the customer resides.
Synonyms: City, Location, Residence

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: credit_score
Description: The credit score of the customer.
Synonyms: Credit Score, Credit Rating, Creditworthiness

Entity: dbo.customers
Column: created_at
Description: The date and time when the customer record was created.
Synonyms: Creation Date, Record Date, Creation Timestamp

Relationship:
dbo.accounts.customer_idreferences dbo.customers.customer_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from accounts table to customers table.

Relationship:
dbo.loans.customer_idreferences dbo.customers.customer_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from loans table to customers table.

Entity: dbo.loans
Description: Loan information including customer ID, loan amount, interest rate, and start date.
Concpets: List of loans, Customer loan details, Loan amount distribution, Interest rate analysis, Loan start dates, Customer loan history, Loan performance metrics, Customer loan statistics

Entity: dbo.loans
Column: loan_id
Description: Unique identifier for each loan.
Synonyms: Loan ID, Loan reference, Unique loan code

Entity: dbo.loans
Column: customer_id
Description: ID of the customer who received the loan.
Synonyms: Customer ID, Customer reference, Loan customer ID

Entity: dbo.loans
Column: loan_amount
Description: Total amount of the loan.
Synonyms: Loan amount, Principal amount, Total loan value

Entity: dbo.loans
Column: interest_rate
Description: Interest rate associated with the loan.
Synonyms: Interest rate, Rate of interest, Loan interest rate

Entity: dbo.loans
Column: start_date
Description: Date when the loan was initiated.
Synonyms: Loan start date, Initiation date, Loan start

Relationship:
dbo.loans.customer_idreferences dbo.customers.customer_id

Description: Foreign key relationship linking loans to customers.

Entity: dbo.merchants
Description: Information about merchants, including their names and cities.
Concpets: merchant details, merchant information, business location, city of merchant, merchant name, merchant ID, business address, merchant contact information

Entity: dbo.merchants
Column: merchant_id
Description: Unique identifier for each merchant.
Synonyms: merchant code, merchant ID number, business ID

Entity: dbo.merchants
Column: merchant_name
Description: Name of the merchant.
Synonyms: merchant name, business name, company name

Entity: dbo.merchants
Column: city
Description: City where the merchant is located.
Synonyms: city of merchant, merchant city, business city

Relationship:
dbo.transactions.merchant_idreferences dbo.merchants.merchant_id

Description: Foreign key relationship where transactions are linked to merchants by merchant ID.

Entity: dbo.transactions
Description: Transactions table contains information about transactions made, including the account that made the transaction, the merchant involved, and the amount in USD.
Concpets: List of transactions, Transaction details, Merchant transactions, Account transactions, Transaction amount, Transaction date, Account ID, Merchant ID

Entity: dbo.transactions
Column: transaction_id
Description: Unique identifier for each transaction
Synonyms: Transaction reference, Transaction ID, Trans ID

Entity: dbo.transactions
Column: account_id
Description: ID of the account that made the transaction
Synonyms: Account reference, Account ID, Acc ID

Entity: dbo.transactions
Column: merchant_id
Description: ID of the merchant involved in the transaction
Synonyms: Merchant reference, Merchant ID, Merch ID

Entity: dbo.transactions
Column: amount_usd
Description: Amount of the transaction in USD
Synonyms: Transaction amount, USD amount, Transaction cost

Entity: dbo.transactions
Column: transaction_date
Description: Date and time when the transaction occurred
Synonyms: Transaction date, Transaction time, Date of transaction

Relationship:
dbo.transactions.account_idreferences dbo.accounts.account_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from transactions to accounts

Relationship:
dbo.transactions.merchant_idreferences dbo.merchants.merchant_id

Description: Foreign key relationship from transactions to merchants
